Publication data availability → fixed Figshare package → Supplemental Note 6, Fig. S8, Tables 1–3 and Supplemental Note 7. Read all S8 arrays and the paired force/torque and EMG numeric CSVs.
scope: Complete upstream ZIP verified by MD5. Detailed offline analysis covers all 28 figure S8 text arrays and 54 human-session force/torque CSV to EMG CSV pairs. Other figure arrays and proprietary SLK exports were not counted as additional independent trials. No executable content was used.
measured: The physical fixture uses one six-axis F/T sensor below the fixed connector and two separate laser displacement sensors observing opposite sides of the translating socket. Initial pin contact is a calibration reference. No separate electrical closure/completion signal. Two-leg reaction forces are model-derived, not two physically independent load cells.
column_interpretation: Figure arrays are headerless and ship without the analysis code or a column dictionary. For S8 only, the plotted axes, time range and traces are consistent with one-based column 1 as seconds, 5 and 6 as opposing laser-travel series in mm, 7 as the rotational waveform in degrees, 8 and 9 as the two model forces and 10 and 11 as symmetric friction bounds (sum zero on every row). Retain positional names; sensor A/B ambiguity cannot change which travel advances more from one direction to the other. The method does not distinguish commanded from measured rotation by column name.
method: Build segments only between successive opposite high-amplitude extrema (regions beyond 80% of the absolute maximum of column 7, midpoint sample of tied extrema). Exclude incomplete outer segments. Trial-level travel from onset uses median over final 100 samples minus median over 100 samples before first 10%-amplitude rotation. These definitions are independent of the authors’ published half-cycle segmentation. Per-row clocks do not prove physical simultaneity.
findings: The archive has 10 LCB30 two-pin, 8 three-pin power-plug and 10 D-sub 25-pin repeats, one physical specimen per type, with 1,768,022 rows. The S8 caption agrees with 10/8/10; Note 6 describes 10 each and Table 2 lists 10 power-plug trials. The additional two are not identifiable in the S8c files. In 243 negative-to-positive complete swings column 5 advances farther in the insertion direction every time; the order reverses on all 255 positive-to-negative swings. Starting preload and missing contact timestamps preclude independent contact-onset or completion time.
human_session_limits: 54 FT/EMG filenames match (three participant directories × three connector prefixes × two modes × three trials); scope exports carry six numeric channels, EMG CSVs five. File pairs have different row counts in every case. EMG spans are 1.6845–13.3874 s shorter than FT spans inferred from the stored export-header FILETIME difference. Analysis preserves different row clocks and excludes explicit maximum/minimum/mean EMG footer rows. No row-wise fused dataset inferred.
